body.name: zu
body.sig: \(z_u(W,\mathcal G,\ell)=\begin{cases}\mathbf 1\{\exists(r,c)\in P_{g_{\mathcal G,\ell}(u)}(W,\mathcal G,\ell):r\ne u\},&g_{\mathcal G,\ell}(u)\in[k],\\1,&g_{\mathcal G,\ell}(u)=\bot.\end{cases}\)
body.def: The indicator that \(u\) is an mleaf in some globally minimum completion, with value one by definition on the fixed singleton-mleaf branch.
